note: The glade's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Mayfly Glade): Elder Thimbleroot inside the stockade gives the first two, Hedgewarden Tansy a few steps north of him the three hunts; Weaver Mossbutton, at the north side of the stockade, is the outfitter; Coachman Twigg keeps the stable on the grass outside the east gate (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes); the mayfly swarms (the hollow south of the stockade), the glade snakes (the woods to the west) and the badger Old Greyback (alone, far to the north-west) are placed for these quests. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Tansy gives L7-L15, Thimbleroot the L20 path; objectives on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (Twigg's coach), as a good neighbor: a quilt, mittens of frostpaw fur, a Rimeheart shard for Dunmore's larder.

L1.name: A Sprout's Acorn Sash
offer: Well, well! A new sprout, and not a crumb on you yet. We shall mend that. But first things first: no brownie of the glade goes about without an acorn sash.
Weaver Mossbutton stitches them, up at the north side of the stockade. Tell her I sent you, or she will talk your ears off first.
Will you fetch your sash and show it to me?
L1.declined: No hurry, sprout. The acorns are not going anywhere.
L1.started: Off you trot. North side, by the big leaves. Follow the humming.

piece.name: acorn-cap sash
piece.description: A sash of plaited grass sewn with acorn caps. Every brownie of Mayfly Glade wears one, and keeps a crumb or two tucked in it.

fetch.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton, at the north side of the stockade, for an acorn-cap sash.
fetch.says: A new sprout! Arms up. Plaited grass, seven acorn caps, one for luck. There. Not a button to pay, dear. Mind you keep it tidy.

show.journal: Show the acorn-cap sash to Elder Thimbleroot.
show.says: Now you look a proper brownie. Keep a crumb tucked in it. You never know when you will want one.

L2.name: Bound to the Glade
offer: The wide world is full of large feet, sprout. Have Spiritmaster Fennick bind your spirit to the glade, so that you wake here if one of them lands on you.
Then give your name to Coachman Twigg for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then look up often, sprout. Very often.
L2.started: Fennick is by the west fence. Twigg waits on the grass outside the east gate.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Fennick, by the west fence of the stockade, bind your spirit to the glade.
bind.says: There now. Whatever lands on you, you will wake here among friends, and likely in time for supper. Off to Coachman Twigg with you.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Twigg, outside the east gate, for his ledger.
ledger.says: Name in the book, sprout! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Splendid. Now you can always come home, one way or the other.
Twigg's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Rivervale is earned. Hedgewarden Tansy, just north of me, has work for you.

L3.name: Mayflies in the Honey
offer: So you are the new sprout. Good, I need quick hands. The mayflies are swarming in the hollow south of the stockade, and they are into the honey pots again.
Swat a few swarms and bring me three wings. Then I will show you a trick worth having.
Will you thin them out?
L3.declined: Then it is dry bread for supper, and you may tell Pippkin why.
L3.started: Three wings. Out the east gate and round to the south, down in the hollow.

drop.name: mayfly wing
drop.description: A glassy wing from a mayfly swarm of the hollow south of the stockade.

hunt.journal: Take three mayfly wings from the mayfly swarms in the hollow south of the stockade.

give.journal: Bring three mayfly wings to Hedgewarden Tansy.
give.says: Three wings, and no honey on your fingers. I am almost surprised. Now watch closely, sprout, and learn this.

L4.name: A Sprout's Arms
offer: A brownie's wits are sharp, but a wolf does not mind wits. I will make you proper gear, if you fetch what I need.
Weaver Mossbutton has a leather strip and a shaft put by for me. Then take a fang from the glade snakes in the woods west of the stockade.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then stay inside the fence, where your wits are enough.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Mossbutton, a fang from the snakes. Hop to it.

materials.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Tansy? Here you are, dear: a strip of leather and a nice straight shaft. Tell her she still has my good needle.

drop.name: glade snake fang
drop.description: The thin fang of a glade snake from the woods west of the stockade.

hunt.journal: Take a glade snake fang from the glade snakes in the woods west of the stockade.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the glade snake fang to Hedgewarden Tansy.
give.says: All three! A moment... the fang for a point, the leather for a grip. There. It is yours, sprout. Do not poke the grocer with it.

L5.name: Old Greyback
offer: One thing more before Rivervale has you. An old badger we call Greyback has dug in among the trees far to the north-west. He has dug up two of our gardens and chased the gardeners up a pine.
He is bigger than three of us and cross as a wet cat, so strike first. Bring me his claw, and I will teach you the last trick I have for a sprout.
Will you see to Old Greyback?
L5.declined: He will not grow any sweeter while you wait.
L5.started: North-west, a good long walk through the trees. Mind his claws.

drop.name: Greyback's claw
drop.description: A blunt grey claw, as long as a brownie's arm, from the badger Old Greyback.

hunt.journal: Take Greyback's claw from the badger Old Greyback in the woods far north-west of the stockade.

give.journal: Bring Greyback's claw to Hedgewarden Tansy.
says: Greyback's own claw! The gardeners can come down from their pine. You are a sprout no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Burrowby at the east gate when you are ready for Rivervale.

flight.name: The Road to Rivervale
offer: The halflings of Rivervale keep good tables and open doors, and they have always been kind to our kind. Tansy says you are ready for them.
You have earned the road, sprout. I will set you down among your own guild in Rivervale, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Rivervale?
flight.declined: Rivervale will keep. Halflings are patient about guests.
flight.started: Mind your manners, and save me a pie!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Burrowby when you are ready to go to Rivervale.

L7.name: A Quilt for the Winter
offer: Winter is coming, sprout, and Thimbleroot's old bones feel it. I mean to stitch him a quilt, and only snowfield badger pelts are warm enough.
Ride Twigg's coach to the Goldfeather Eyrie. The badgers dig on the snow east of the hunters' outpost there. Bring me two pelts, nice and thick.
Will you fetch two badger pelts?
L7.declined: Then the elder shivers a little longer.
L7.started: Two pelts. Badgers are Greyback's cousins, and just as cross.

drop.name: snowfield badger pelt
drop.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring two snowfield badger pelts to Hedgewarden Tansy in the glade.
give.says: Oh, they are lovely and warm! The elder will purr like a cat. Now, sprout, a trick for your trouble. Learn this.

L10.name: A Sprout No More
offer: You have outgrown your little arms, sprout. Time for proper ones. Mossbutton has a leather strip for me, and the Eyrie's quartermaster has iron.
Then bring me two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost. Nothing binds a grip like it.
Will you gather it all?
L10.declined: Then mind you do not break the old ones.
L10.started: Mossbutton first, she is on the way. Then Dunmore, then the spiders.

materials.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton at the stockade for Tansy's leather strip.
materials.says: Tansy's strip? Here it is, sprout, and here is a crumb for the road. Do not tell Tansy. She says I spoil you.

materials.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for iron ore.
materials.says: A brownie? Tansy's? Well, I owe the glade for that honey cake. Here is your ore. Carry it with both hands.

drop.name: rime spider silk
drop.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the iron ore and the rime spider silk to Hedgewarden Tansy.
give.says: All of it! Iron for the edge, leather and silk for the grip... there. It is yours, and it is no toy. Do not poke the grocer.

L13.name: Mittens for the Little Ones
offer: The little sprouts of the glade have cold paws this year, and I have promised them mittens. The softest fur there is grows on the frostpaw cubs.
They play on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost. Bring me three tufts of their fur. Hunt with the other homes: those cubs bite.
Will you fetch three tufts?
L13.declined: Then the little ones blow on their paws a while longer.
L13.started: Three tufts. Mind the cubs. They are bigger than they look.

drop.name: frostpaw tuft
drop.description: A tuft of thick white fur from a frostpaw cub of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take three frostpaw tufts from the frostpaw cubs north of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring three frostpaw tufts to Hedgewarden Tansy.
give.says: So soft! The little ones will have the warmest paws in the Homelands. You deserve a good trick for this. Learn it.

L15.name: Cold for the Larder
offer: The Eyrie's quartermaster tells me there is a thing of ice in the caves north-east of his outpost. The Rimeheart, they call it. Ice that never melts!
Dunmore's stores spoil like ours do. Break the Rimeheart and take him a shard, and his larder stays cold all summer. Then come home to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
L15.declined: Then the butter melts, and the caves stay cold.
L15.started: Take friends, sprout, and come home in one piece.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: Ice that never melts, for my larder? Tansy said a brownie would think of it. Tell her the honey cakes are on me this winter.

back.journal: Return to Hedgewarden Tansy in the glade.
back.says: Dunmore's larder is cold and the Rimeheart is broken. You are a hedgewarden in all but name, sprout. Learn this.

L20.name: A Good Neighbor
offer: Tansy tells me you have kept the whole Eyrie in honey cakes and cold butter. Splendid! A brownie is a good neighbor, sprout, and so are you.
The Eyrie's folk could use a good neighbor now. Ask Quartermaster Dunmore what they need, and help them. Then come home and tell me all.
Will you go and be a good neighbor?
L20.declined: Neighbors keep. Come when you are ready.
L20.started: Twigg's coach will take you. Mind your manners!

road.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost what the outpost needs.
road.says: What do we need? Quiet nights. The raiders keep the warden up. Go and ask Warden Halvek, he will tell you more than I.

road.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Dunmore sent you? The Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of here steal from our camp. Two of their war-talons would warn them off.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take two war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the two war-talons to Warden Halvek.
handin.says: Two talons. They will think twice about our camp now. The glade raises good neighbors. Go home and tell your elder so.

final.journal: Return to Elder Thimbleroot in the glade.
final.says: Halvek's thanks came by the coach, and a honey cake with it. You went out a sprout and came home a neighbor to every home. Now choose your path.
